source.citation: System, Inc. (2026). System Public Graph (Version 2.1) [Data set]. DOI: https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/7V6JDO
notes: The Graph has no geography field: countries are matched from the free text of each study's population description.
The Graph has no per-finding publication date: dates and titles come from OpenAlex, looked up by PubMed ID or DOI.
System's documentation says about 20% of associations served by the API are known-bad extractions; these findings have not been checked against the papers.
255 SP findings have no study record, so they have no population text and their country is unknown.

selectionRule: Variables were found by name search in the System Public Graph API (terms for sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine and for pfdhps/dihydropteroate synthase, including K540E and 540E), then all associations of the kept variables were fetched. A finding is 'sp' when a variable name refers to SP (sulfadoxine, sulphadoxine, Fansidar, SP, SPAQ, IPTp-SP) and no dhps variable is involved. A finding is 'codon540' when a variable name explicitly includes 540E (for example K540E, 540K/E, Glu-540, dhps540Glu); dhps findings that do not name 540E are excluded. A country is attached only when its name appears in the Graph study population text or in a variable name. Only findings naming at least one country are listed.
